versions.changelog:
Initial release – quality objective decomposition and audit assistant for QMS.

- Supports two modes: (1) Decomposition—generates a three-dimensional goal matrix (department/process/time) from company-level quality objectives with SMART validation; (2) Audit—diagnoses conformance of existing quality objective documents to ISO 9001:2015 Clause 6.2, outputting severity-based suggestions.
- Enforces five universal interaction rules for clarity, traceability, and compliance.
- Distinctly separates what the skill can and cannot do; never invents data or replaces user decisions.
- Multi-format input support: processes plain text, `.docx`, `.xlsx`, and `.md` documents.
- Built-in script support for SMART checks, matrix formatting, and structured audit—outputs ready-to-use matrices, validation reports, and audit advice.
- Integrates upstream with related strategy and policy analysis tools, ensuring traceable objective decomposition in quality management systems.
